vibe_rationale: Big gravel gathering in a resort town with a genuine riding community, but a sport ride with a tyre-brand title partner rather than a culture festival.
fit_notes: Travelling adult endurance riders (about 60 per cent from outside Hokkaido), with sport brands already in (Shimano, POC, Vivobarefoot), so hydration and recovery sampling fits. Panaracer holds the title, so access is scored locked, though secondary partner slots may exist. Japan-based.
